title: 第1章 企鹅：用心创造快乐
slug: 次元论坛全本免费-次元论坛最新章节列表
content_zh:
“@*（……！@！”
好吧，这一定是开篇最玄奥的一本书，上来就是两句作为地球人的关立远完全听不懂的话！
不仅听不懂，而且他可以肯定，这不是他听过的任何一种语言，不过他却知道，说话的人对他不是很友好。
之所以得出这个结论，不是因为关立远是行为社会学的大师，而是因为他已经被人按在地上了。
“一穿越就被四名语言不通的大汉，按在地上biu怎么办？在线等。”关立远在心中吐槽了一句。
但是还好这几名看上去应该是仆人的大汉，并没有把他“biu”了的意思，而是将他包括脸在内全身都按在地上之后，掰着他的手，要往一张契约上按的样子……
“搞什么鬼？这是什么契约？我又不是魂穿，我有什么可卖的吗？”关立远心中吐槽着，但是年仅十四岁的他，显然是不是四名大汉的对手！
虽然明知道这契约绝对不是什么好东西，但最后还是按下去了……
之后大汉们没有再按着他，而是一副看好戏的样子。
看关立远面前站着的这位做主的中年人的表情就知道……笑得这么奸诈，这契约会是什么好东西？
而且这时关立远终于想起来，自己有什么能卖的了！
既然是身体穿越，能卖的唯一东西，自然就是他自己了！
“搞什么啊！一穿越就被人卖了，还有比我更惨的穿越者吗？”关立远在倍感无助的同时，也在心里默默地哀叹着。
而就在这时，他面前突然出现了一块半透明的面板，这种熟悉的格式……很显然是某种论坛！
吓了一跳的关立远连忙向四周看了看，却发现这面板似乎是与自己视角绑定的，而且其他人看不到的样子。
与此同时，一道声音在关立远的脑海中响起……
【叮咚，您的帖子有新回复。】
“帖子？什么帖子？这、这东西还真是发帖的？”
关立远心中刚刚有了查看的念头，便见到所谓的“帖子”，题目正是之前自己在心里吐槽的那句【一穿越就被四名语言不通的大汉，按在地上biu怎么办？在线等。】
而且这莫名其妙的论坛，人气真的爆高，转眼已经有不少人回复了！

现在四名大汉已经松开了他，仿佛一点也不担心他逃走一样，而那名獐头鼠目的中年人，则是满意的看着手里的契约，之后用一种看肥肉的眼神，看着面前好像傻了的关立远……
趁着这功夫，关立远查看了一下现在唯一能指望上的东西……
【凭你们的精神速度，也想抢新人的一血？沙发我拿下了！】
【笑摸三楼狗头！】
【“biu”字很传神。】
【咦？居然有新人？可惜已经被人“biu”了……】
关立远脸色一阵发黑，前面十几楼，没有任何有用的信息！
终于在第十四楼的时候，令他感觉到了人道主义的关怀。
【你们能不能正经点？没看到新人有麻烦了吗！等等，这次的新人居然也是的“穿越者”？好吧，看在大家都是穿越者的份儿上，我打赏你1个论坛币，你可以用来开启翻译功能，虽然还是要被别人biu，但至少可以知道，被“biu”的时候对方在说什么……】
系统提示的声音再次响起：【叮咚，“八连杀食神”打赏给您1论坛币，已存入余额。】
正当关立远想要问问，自己应该如何使用论坛币的时候，发现自己连回复帖子都不会……
还好就在这时，一道更加宏大的声音响起，与之前的系统提示音完全不同，仿佛天地开辟之时的第一道声响！
【用心创造快乐！】
伴随着天地开辟之声出现的，是一只企鹅……一只带着红围脖的企鹅！
关立远看到企鹅的瞬间，心中千般万绪，想起了之前被人按在地上biu的种种委屈，千言万语汇聚成了一句话：“我要充钱！我要变强！”
周围其他人看着关立远，对这空气咆哮着听不懂的话，一些围观的路人面露不忍之色，不过被拿着契约的中年人一瞪眼，便纷纷退缩了。
显然企鹅也是其他人看不见的，这时露出一个人性化的疑惑表情：“哈？醒一醒，少年，你哪有钱？”
“我、我有一个论坛币……或者我可以裸贷吗？”关立远心虚的说道。
“本平台只提供论坛服务，不提供贷款服务……至于那一个论坛币，我建议你用来兑换‘大宇宙翻译’的功能。”企鹅说道。

content_en:
"@*(...!@!"
Well, this must be the most mysterious book at the beginning. It starts with two sentences that Guan Liyuan, an earthling, cannot understand at all!
Not only did he not understand it, but he was certain that this was not any language he had ever heard. However, he knew that the speaker was not very friendly to him.
The reason for reaching this conclusion is not because Guan Liyuan is a master of behavioral sociology, but because he has been pinned to the ground.
"What should I do if I was pinned to the ground by four big men who didn't understand the language as soon as I traveled through time? Wait online." Guan Liyuan complained in his heart.
But fortunately, these big men who seemed to be servants did not mean to "biu" him. Instead, after pressing his body including his face to the ground, they took his hands and pressed them on a contract...
"What the hell? What kind of contract is this? I'm not soul-piercing, what do I have to sell?" Guan Liyuan complained in his heart, but at only fourteen years old, he was obviously no match for four big men!
Although I knew that this contract was definitely not a good thing, I still pressed it in the end...
After that, the big men didn't hold him down anymore, but looked like they were watching a good show.
Just look at the expression of the middle-aged man who makes the decision standing in front of Guan Liyuan... He smiles so treacherously, what good thing can this contract be?
And then Guan Liyuan finally remembered that he had something to sell!
Since it's body time travel, the only thing that can be sold is naturally himself!
"What are you doing! I was sold as soon as I traveled through time. Is there any time traveler who is worse off than me?" Guan Liyuan felt helpless and silently lamented in his heart.
At this moment, a translucent panel suddenly appeared in front of him. This familiar format... was obviously some kind of forum!
Startled, Guan Liyuan quickly looked around, only to find that the panel seemed to be bound to his own perspective and could not be seen by others.
At the same time, a voice sounded in Guan Liyuan's mind...
[Ding Dong, there is a new reply to your post. 】
"Post? What post? This, this thing is really posted?"
Guan Liyuan just had the idea of checking it out when he saw the so-called "post". The title was exactly what he had complained about in his mind before: "What should I do if I am pushed to the ground by four big men who cannot understand the language as soon as I time travel?" Waiting online. 】
Moreover, this inexplicable forum has really exploded in popularity, and many people have already replied in a blink of an eye!
Now the four big men had let go of him, as if they were not worried about him escaping at all. The middle-aged man with the deer-headed eyes looked at the contract in his hand with satisfaction, and then looked at Guan Liyuan, who seemed to be stupid in front of him, with a fat look...
Taking advantage of this time, Guan Liyuan checked the only thing he could count on now...
[With your mental speed, you also want to steal the newcomer’s first blood? I got the sofa! 】
[Laugh and touch the dog’s head on the third floor! 】
[The word "biu" is very expressive. 】
【Huh? There's actually a newcomer? It's a pity that it has been "biu"...]
Guan Liyuan's face turned dark. There was no useful information on the ten floors ahead!
Finally on the fourteenth floor, he felt the humanitarian concern.
[Can you guys be more serious? Don’t you see that the newcomer is in trouble? Wait, the newcomer this time is actually a "traveler"? Well, for the sake of everyone being time-travelers, I will reward you with 1 forum coin, which you can use to turn on the translation function. Although you still have to be misunderstood by others, you can at least know what the other person is saying when being "biued over"...]
The system prompts again: [Ding dong, "Eight Consecutive Kills of the God of Cookery" will reward you with 1 forum coin, and the balance has been deposited. 】
Just when Guan Liyuan wanted to ask how he should use the forum currency, he found outNow I can’t even reply to posts…
Fortunately, at this moment, a louder sound sounded, which was completely different from the previous system prompts. It was like the first sound when the world opened up!
【Create happiness with heart! 】
Along with the sound of the world opening up, a penguin appeared...a penguin wearing a red scarf!
The moment Guan Liyuan saw the penguin, he felt a myriad of emotions in his heart. He remembered all the grievances he had suffered when he was pinned to the ground and biued. Thousands of words converged into one sentence: "I want to top up my money! I want to become stronger!"
Others around looked at Guan Liyuan and roared incomprehensible words into the air. Some passers-by looked unbearable, but after being glared at by the middle-aged man holding the contract, they all retreated.
Obviously Penguin was invisible to others, and he showed a human expression of confusion: "Huh? Wake up, young man, how can you have money?"
"I, I have a forum currency...or can I borrow money naked?" Guan Liyuan said with a guilty conscience.
"This platform only provides forum services, not loan services... As for that forum currency, I suggest you use it to redeem the 'Big Universe Translation' function." Penguin said.
